definitions.meaning: a fence; a hag, an enclosure

source_text: hæg a fence; a hag, an enclosure :-- Terram nominatam Haeg, C. D. i. 49, 23. The word is found forming the first part of local names, Hægdún, Hæghyll, Hægleá; also in other words, hæg-steald, hæg-þorn. See, too, ge-hæg, and cf. haga; hecg, hecge, hege.
